## Publication Information

**Date:** 1859

**Imprint:** <i>Saturday Review</i> (24 December 1859) 768-9

**Notes:** A review of  <i>Aggesden Vicarage</i>: ‘in point of literary ability, this seems to us the best of all the imitations of Miss Yonge’.
